name: A 10-Year Maintenance Plan for Newly Refinished Floors
title-tag: A 10-Year Maintenance Plan for Refinished Hardwood Floors
meta-description: Your refinished floor should go a decade before the next sanding. The year-by-year plan: the critical first week, safe cleaners, and the $1.99 recoat.
post-summary: January 8, 2027 · A refinished floor fails from habits, not foot traffic. Here’s the decade-long plan we’d follow in our own houses: a sacred first week, an almost-nothing cleaning routine, and the $1.99/sq ft recoat at year 5–7 that keeps the floor off the $3.99 full-resand list.
